newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tuskar shareholders give go-ahead to placing.
newsitem.headline: Tuskar shareholders give go-ahead to placing.

text.p: Irish exploration group Tuskar Resources plc said on Monday that its shareholders agreed to grant authority to the Board to place shares for cash up to a maximum of 10 percent of its issued share capital.

"The authority granted today provides the Board with the flexibility to move promptly to place shares with prospective institutional investors and thus providing an important first step in broadening and strengthening the shareholder base," Tuskar said in a statement.

It said Tuskar Resources needs to attract the support of strong institutional investors if it is to grow to the extent possible, given the opportunities which the Board expects will be presented toTuskar over the foreseeable future.
Such opportunities will require substantial capital investment in order to realise their potential for the benefit of all shareholders, it said.
Tuskar Resources plc is an independent oil and gas company whose shares are traded on the Irish Exploration Securities Market (ESM) with dealings in Dublin and London, the statement said.
